import pandas as pd, glob
allrows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f); d['carrier']=f.split('/')[-1][:2]
 datecol='date_utc' if 'date_utc' in d else 'date'
 d['flight_date']=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol])
 d['route']=d.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r['origin'],r['dest']])),axis=1)
 allrows.append(d)
x=pd.concat(allrows,ignore_index=True)
print('rows',len(x),'unique flight ids',x.flight_id.nunique(),'duplicates',x.flight_id.duplicated().sum())
print(x[x.flight_id.duplicated(False)].sort_values('flight_id')[['flight_id','carrier','flight_date','origin','dest']].to_string(index=False))
print('date range',x.flight_date.min(),x.flight_date.max(), 'month counts',x.flight_date.dt.month.value_counts().sort_index().to_dict())
# dedupe exact? unique flight id
u=x.drop_duplicates('flight_id')
print(u.route.value_counts().head(15).to_string())
print('top rows',u.groupby('route').size().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10).to_dict())

import pandas as pd, glob
ap=pd.read_csv('airports.csv').set_index('airport')
parts=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f)
 if 'date_utc' in d:
  # scheduled local date = UTC date+time adjusted by origin UTC offset
  utc=pd.to_datetime(d['date_utc']+' '+d['sched_dep_utc'])
  d['local_sched_dt']=[t+pd.Timedelta(hours=float(ap.loc[o,'utc_offset_hours'])) for t,o in zip(utc,d.origin)]
 else:
  d['local_sched_dt']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']+' '+d['sched_dep'])
 d['route']=[ '-'.join(sorted((o,de))) for o,de in zip(d.origin,d.dest)]
 parts.append(d)
x=pd.concat(parts,ignore_index=True).drop_duplicates('flight_id')
sel=x[(x.local_sched_dt>='2025-01-01')&(x.local_sched_dt<'2025-03-01')]
counts=sel.groupby('route').size().sort_values(ascending=False)
print('all unique',len(x),'selected',len(sel), 'excluded',len(x)-len(sel))
print('excluded AS/local dates',x[(x.local_sched_dt<'2025-01-01')|(x.local_sched_dt>='2025-03-01')][['flight_id','origin','date_utc','sched_dep_utc','local_sched_dt']].to_string(index=False))
print(counts.head(10).to_string())
print(counts.head(5).index.tolist())

events.notes: Combined all carrier files, deduplicated repeated flight_id records, counted cancelled flights, canonicalized each route alphabetically, and ranked by scheduled-flight count. For AS, the UTC schedule fields were converted to the origin airport's local date before applying the January-February 2025 period; all 1,932 unique flights fell in the period.
